buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Terms & Conditions for outsourcing services {2 Security Guards (without arms) for 12 Months/365 days}

1. The Contractor shall be considered for award of contract only if they agree to abide by the following Terms & Conditions: a) Bidder should have a minimum of 3 years and above of experience in providing man power ser vices, for outsourcing services of Security guards to various government organizations an d should be a Private Limited Company/Partnership Firm/Proprietary concern registered as per relevant Act. b) The bidder must have ESI Registration, EPF Registration, Goods and Service Tax Registration a nd Labour Licence from the date of incorporation of the company/office/organization or from th e year on which the bidder has come into the purview of various statutory authorities. c) The bidder must have obtained Permanent Account Number (PAN) under Income Tax Act, 1961 and should have filed income tax return within the due date. d) The evidence for filing of returns along with supporting documents based on which the return o f income was filed like P&L, Expenditure Account, Balance Sheet Schedules, 44 AB report for p ast three Financial Years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 (Assessment Years 2024-25, 2025-26 & 2026-27) should be enclosed along with the Qualifying Bid. e) The bidder must have gross contractual receipts of Rs. 25,00,000/- and above for last three Fin ancial Years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 (Assessment Years 2024-25, 2025-26 & 2026-27). A statement showing list of clients and number of employees employed, its contractual receipt s and date of receipt along with the payment details like payment made (in Rs.) date of payme nt to the statutory dues like PF, ESI etc. and date of payment of salary to the employees’ mont h wise should be enclosed along with the Qualifying Bid. f) Bidders are strictly advised not to participate, if the geographical presence of company is out of Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram & Vellore Jurisdictions. (Rental Agreements is no t considered as a proof of Geographical presence). g) The bidder should have at least 100 employees on the pay roll (enclose ESI contribution for pr oof) h) During the past 5 years no government organization should have disqualified or black listed th e bidder. There should be no disputes involving clients on the basis of the terms of contract wi th bidder. A self-declaration certificate should be enclosed in the technical bid. List of cases w ith full details where the bidder is involved in disputes with various statutory authorities with y ear, date and remarks mentioning the nature of dispute, should also be enclosed, if any. i) The bidder should have enough funds for payment of salary to the employees in the event of a ny unforeseen circumstances of non-payment of claim by the department to the bidder. Whet her department makes payment or not the bidder should make full payment to the employees on the due date of 10th of every month. j) The bidder should have paid all the statutory dues like PF, ESI, Bonus etc., and salary to the em ployees on the due date for which the payment has been received from the existing clients as per the contract and as per the due date under various statutory authorities. A self-declaratio n certificate mentioning the above in this regard should be enclosed along with the technical b id. k) The bidder should be a Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram & Vellore based concern. It s Registered Office, Head Office and Corporate Office and place of Effective Management shoul d be situated in Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram & Vellore only. (Rental Agreements i s not considered as a proof of Geographical presence). l) Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. The Department will not take any responsibility in this regard. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower) subject to the maximum of quoted GST percentage.

m) Bidder’s offer is liable to be rejected if they don’t upload any of the certificates/documents sou ght in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. n) The bidder should attach Nationalized Banker Solvency Certificate for Rs. 25 Lakh which shoul d be within one month of date of this tender document. o) In the event of any of the above conditions not being satisfied the tender will be rejected and t he Finance Bid will not be opened. p) In the event of the contract being awarded, the contractor should be prepared to deploy the personnel w.e.f. 06.11.2026 (approximately 2 Security guards). q) The Service Provider should quote the service charges as a percentage of monthly wage bills e xclusive of GST. As per DoE OM No.F/6/1/2023-PPD dated 06.01.2023, the minimum service c harges is fixed as 3.85% (3% profit plus transaction charges which are 0.85% at present) as pr oposed by the Government e-Marketing (GeM). If a bidder is found to have quoted less than t he minimum service charges, then their bid will be summarily rejected. r) Earnest Money Deposit: Earnest Money Deposit of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) per application in the form of Demand Draft / Banker’s check of scheduled bank drawn in favor of Income Tax Officer/ DDO, Plot No.2, J N Road, Tiruvallur - 602001 shall accompany t he qualifying bid. Qualifying bids without Earnest Money Deposit will be rejected. EMD will be returned to all the unsuccessful bidders at the end of the selection process. However, the EMD shall be forfeited in case the successful bidder withdraws subsequently or the details furnished are found to be incorrect or false during the tender selection process. No interest shall be paid on the Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of the successful bidder and same will be returned on fur nishing a Performance Guarantee. s) Performance Guarantee: The successful bidder has to submit 5% of the value of the contrac t as performance guarantee deposit in the form of Demand Draft / Banker’s cheque of a Sched ule bank drawn in favour of “Income Tax Officer/ DDO, Plot No.2, J N Road, Tiruvallur - 602001” before the contract is awarded to them. The Performance Guarantee shall be refund ed to the selected bidder on successful completion of contract period. No interest shall be paid on the Performance Security placed with the Department by the successful bidder. The Perfor mance Guarantee will be forfeited in the event of withdrawal of contract by the contractor bef ore the expiry of the contract period or in the event of termination of the contract attributable to the unsatisfactory performance of the contract or for violation of any of the terms and condit ions of the contract. 2. HUMAN RESOURCE SECURITY POLICY:- In the event of the contract being awarded, the contractor should adhere Human Resource Security polic y requirements as follows and submit the related document within a week’s time of award of contract. a) Job Description - Roles and responsibilities: All job roles and responsibilities must be documented and must include general as well as spec ific responsibilities for implementing the same. All employees must understand their job roles a nd responsibilities. b) Background Checks: Background Checks must be performed on all personnel performing sensitive or critical jobs rol es before they are selected for the position. c) Terms and Conditions of Employment: All employees as users of the Department’s Information Assets must sign and agree terms and conditions of their employment contract. These terms and conditions must state the organizat

ion’s as well as employee’s responsibilities towards Information security. d) Management Responsibilities: All Supervisory roles are responsible for the performance and conduct of the staff personnel re porting to them. e) Confidentiality Agreements: All Contractual employees of Contractors must sign appropriate confidentiality agreements to protect confidential and sensitive information of the organization. All employees of Contractors are required to agree sign non-disclosure obligation. Users are re quired not to disclose organizational information derived as result of their access to Departme nt’s information Systems to unauthorized parties. Actions would be taken against contractual workers and third party vendors for any violations as per law and as per terms of agreement. f) Information Security Training and Awareness : Information Security Training and Awareness programs must be provided to all employees. g) Disciplinary Process and penal process : There must be a formal disciplinary process for employees and penal process for contractors w ho have violated the organizational security policies and procedures. 3. GENERAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT:- (1) The service provider has to deploy the required numbers of 02 Security Guards at the Income Tax Office, Tiruvallur. The working hours for the Security Guard will be round the clock in 24/7 for the e ntire period of agreement. (2) Unsuitable for PwBD (Physically challenged with Benchmark Disabilities). Hence Contractor/Securit y agency provide physically sounded personal only. (3) The contractor shall deploy only personnel with good conduct and character. In order to ensure the same, Police Verification Certificates in respect of the personnel deployed shall be submitted to th e Income Tax Officer/ DDO, Plot No.2, J N Road, Tiruvallur - 602001, at the time of deploym ent of each personnel. (4) The contractor shall ensure that its personal shall have Identity Cards, provided by the contractor which shall be worn in such a way that it is prominently displayed and visible so that any person re presenting the contractor can be easily identified. (5) The personnel shall attend to work punctually at the prefixed / determined timings and shall be wel l behaved and well mannered. (6) The personnel shall perform all the duties assigned by the respective HODs / Assessing Officers / O fficers to whom they are attached from time to time. (7) The contractor is responsible for payment of salary to the personnel deployed. (8) The contractor shall ensure that the work undertaken by its personnel is carried out efficiently and to the satisfaction of Heads of the Departments (HODs) / Assessing Officers / Officers to whom the y are attached. (9) The contractor and the personnel engaged by the contractor shall be subject to the entry and exit procedures of the Department as may be determined by the Department from time to time. (10) If in the opinion of this office, the contractor engages inadequate number of personnel or does no t execute the work in a satisfactory manner or in accordance with the terms and conditions of the c ontract, Income Tax Officer/ DDO, Plot No.2, J N Road, Tiruvallur - 602001 may get the wor k done through a third party contractor, without any written notice to the contractor, the cost of w

hich shall be recovered from the contractor from the monthly payment. A penalty of Rs.10,000/- would be levied by the department on each occasion the contractor found to have failed in his con tractual obligations. (11) In the event Income Tax Officer/ DDO, Plot No.2, J N Road, Tiruvallur – 602001 deciding to renew this contract on the same terms as embodied or such other modified terms as it may think f it and proper, it shall communicate the decision to the contractor prior to the expiry of this agreem ent, in which event the parties to this agreement shall be governed by such documents for future or further transactions. (12) Close liaison shall be maintained with our officers-in-charge for smooth and efficient performance of duties of the personnel. (13) The contractor shall indemnify and shall keep the Income Tax Officer/ DDO, Office of the Income- Tax officer, Tiruvallur, Plot No.2, J N Road, Tiruvallur - 602001 indemnified against acts or omission or negligence, dishonesty or misconduct of the men engaged for the work and Income Tax Officer/ DDO, Office of the Income-Tax officer, Tiruvallur, Plot No.2, J N Road, Tiruvallur – 602001 shall not be liable to pay for any damages or compensation to such personnel or to third party. (14) In the event of increase in Service Tax by State/Central Government in future applicable under thi s contract, the Department shall bear the same. (15) In the event of increase in Dearness Allowance under Minimum Wages Act / Service Tax by State / Central Government in future, during the period of contract, the department shall bear the same. (16) The contractor shall arrange for the maintenance of all such registers and forms as are statutorily required and / or considered necessary for the efficient performance of this contract. (17) It is clearly agreed and understood that all the personnel provided / engaged by the contractor sh all be the employees of the contractor and all disputes between the contractor and its personnel s hall have no bearing on Income Tax Officer/ DDO, Plot No.2, J N Road, Tiruvallur – 602001 and this office shall not be responsible for any claims made by such personnel and shall not be liable to pa y any amount to any employee / ex-employee of the contractor. (18) The contractor is fully responsible for disciplined behavior of its workmen. There must be a formal disciplinary process for employees and penal process for contractors who have violated the organiz ational security policies and procedures. (19) All damages caused by the contractor or the contractor’s personnel or by any other personnel ari sing out of the contractor’s employee’s instructions shall be charged to the contractors and recove red from its dues / bills. (20) Failure by the contractor to comply with any statutory requirement and / or the terms of the agre ement during the period of contract shall result in termination of the contract and subsequent disq ualification from participation in any future tender of the Department. (21) In case the contractor withdraws or the Income Tax Officer/ DDO, Plot No.2, J N Road, Tiruvallur – 602001 terminates the contract for violation of any of the terms and conditions and / or deficiency in services during the period of contract, the additional expenses in hiring a new contract or tempo rary arrangement till the time of appointing a regular contractor through a similar tender process, shall be adjusted against payments to be made. (22) The department reserves the rights to suspend this tendering process without assigning any reason, whatsoever. The department reserves the right to reject or cancel any or all tenders or to open selected financial bids as approved by the committee without assigning any reason. On the best of the technical bids as decided by the committee only will be considered for opening of finan cial bid. Quoting of lowest is not the only eligibility for a successful bid. Technical and Financial bi d both will be looked into for awarding final contract. It also reserves the right to enter into or reje

ct all application depending on the availability of resources. (23) The service charges quoted shall be inclusive of cost of issue of identity cards, uniform, other exp enses relating to maintenance of register or supervisory charges and other charges to be incurred by the contractor to satisfy the terms and conditions of tender. (24) In case, the personnel deployed by the contractor is absent / leave, suitable replacement should be given immediately with information to the Income Tax Officer/ DDO, Plot No.2, J N Road, Tiruvall ur - 602001. (25) The personnel deployed by the contractor should maintain the confidentiality of the work carried out by them and it is also to be ensured that they should not remove or partake any material that belongs to the department. (26) In case, complaints are received against the personnel deployed by the contractor and if the com plaints are found to be guilty/engaging malpractices in any manner the O/o the ITO/DDO reserves t he right to initiate further proceedings against the personnel. (27) If the service provided by the contractor is found to be satisfactory, the contract may be extend ed for the period as agreed to by both the parties (contractor and the department) under the same rates and same terms and conditions. (28) The total number of Security guards deployed shall be at the sole discretion of this office. (29) Insurance cover protecting the service provider against all claims applicable under the Workmen’ s Compensation Act, 1948 shall be taken by the Contractor. The contractor shall arrange necessar y insurance cover for any personnel deployed by him even for short duration. This office shall not e ntertain any claim arising out of mishap, if any that may take place. In the event of any liability / c laim falling on this office, same shall be reimbursed/indemnified by the contractor. (30) Licence from Labour Department as per section 12 of Contract Labour (R&A) Act, 1970 shall be o btained for the contract work within 7 days of award of contract. (31) In terms of the Contract Labour (R & A) Act, 1970, the contractor shall pay to their personnel a minimum wage at the prevailing rate as fixed under the Minimum Wage Act, 1940 (Central Govern ment rates) and any breach of this condition shall be liable for termination of the contract and the same would be dealt with accordingly. Besides, ESI and P.F. per head at the current rate shall be paid by the contractor every month, as per the existing rules. (32) The contractor is responsible for payment of monthly salary including leave salary, bon us, gratuity etc. to the personnel as applicable to them under law. The contractor should ensure that salaries are paid on time every month. (33) The persons engaged by the Contracting Service Provider / Contractor will be in the employment of the Service Provider / Contractor only. The contractor is responsible for payment of salary to the personnel deployed. (34) It shall be the responsibility of the Contractor to comply with the service conditions of its employe es including fixation and payment of their wages. However, in order to keep the Department infor med, for the purposes of the Department's statutory responsibilities and liabilities if any, as may b e applicable from time to time, the Contractor shall intimate the Department, the details of wages paid to the workmen and if the need arises to depute its representative to be present at the time a nd place of disbursement of wages by the Contractor and inspect relevant records if any. The Dep artment shall verify such payments made in the wage register maintained by the Contractor. (35) The Department/Office will not involve in any dispute between the contractor and workers of the contractor.

(36) The Security Agency shall provide proper uniform and identity cards with required accessories su ch as whistle, torch lights, batons, etc. to the Security Guards and shall ensure that their turnout is smart in all respects. Rain boots and rain coats shall also be provided to them during the rainy sea son. (37) The contractor shall provide the personal particulars of the Security guards to be deployed, givin g details of educational qualifications. (38) The Security Guards {Watch & Ward (without arms)} are required to abide by the following rules: a) Will work in the Income Tax Office premises only. b) Will not part with any information pertaining to the office. c) All employees as users of the Department’s Information Assets must sign and agree terms and conditions of their employment contract. These terms and conditions must state the o rganization’s as well as employee’s responsibilities towards Information security. (39) During the contract period, the service provider shall make salary and other payments and provid e other things in time without waiting for the bill payments passed and paid by the Income Tax de partment. In case it is seen that the payments of salaries have been withheld for the reason that th e same have not been paid by the department, the service provider shall be debarred from partici pating in the next tender to be floated by the department. (40) The Income Tax Department may discontinue the contract at any point of time, by giving notice of at least 30 days before the intended date of discontinuation, and will not be liable to any additio nal charges or compensation payable to the service provider or any other person. (41) The service provider shall discontinue the contract at any point of time by giving notice at least 60 days before the intended date of discontinuance. But it will amount to forfeiture of its security d eposit submitted by it in case of discontinuation without notice and notice less than 60 days prior t o the intended discontinuation. Income Tax Department will have the right to claim damages and r ecover them from the payments due to the service provider or by any other means in addition to f orfeiting the security deposit of the service provider. (42) No negotiation shall be undertaken with any tenderer except the lowest qualified bidder. (43) The Bidder would be wholly responsible for the job to be performed. NO SUBLETTING OR SUBCON TRACTING WOULD BE ALLOWED. 4. Evaluation of Technical & Financial Bid: a.
